sloka: तस्य सम्दिदिहे बुद्धिः मुहुः सीताम् निरीक्ष्य तु ।आम्नायानाम् अयोगेन विद्याम् प्रशिथिलाम् इव ॥५-१५-३८॥
transliteration: tasya samdidihe buddhiḥ muhuḥ sītām nirīkṣya tu ।āmnāyānām ayogena vidyām praśithilām iva ॥5-15-38॥

translations.english: Hanuman did recognise Sita after looking at her carefully again and again even as one is able to make out knowledge of shastriclore forgotten with lapse of time and lack of practice.
